methodologyNotes: The roster covers 13 widely searched US child car seat models spanning infant, convertible, all-in-one, and booster categories. Primary sources were official manufacturer product pages (gracobaby.com, chiccousa.com, us.britax.com, nunababy.com, clekinc.com, evenflo.com, cybex-online.com, maxicosi.com, diono.com) corroborated by specialist review sites (safeintheseat.com, csftl.org, carseatblog.com) and major retailer listings (babycubby.com, target.com). Weight limits are in US pounds (lb), height limits in inches (in); steel_frame is a boolean indicating a manufacturer-confirmed steel or steel-reinforced structural element (null when not confirmed by the manufacturer); expiration_years is the manufacturer-stated seat lifespan; install values are "latch", "belt", or "both". Adversarial re-verification 2026-06-19: corrected Britax One4Life price ($449.99->$439.99 per official page), Nuna PIPA rx price ($379.95->$550.00 per multiple retailers for the rx+RELX base config), and replaced a locked (HTTP 423) Diono store URL with a working authorized-retailer URL. All accessedAt 2026-06-19.
